shared_boundaries.all_restore_inputs: Fresh case-specific private files with exact22 bytes owned-invalid-snapshot; never send a valid saved archive back to restore.
shared_boundaries.credential_source: PhaseA fresh synthetic random token only. PhaseB root from that new owned init. Environment is minimal and explicit; no live token helper or real client profiles. Do not expose tokens inargv/public logs.
shared_boundaries.default_cli_environment: No inherited BAO_/VAULT_/proxy variables. Explicit BAO_ADDR, BAO_CACERT, BAO_TOKEN, BAO_CLIENT_TIMEOUT=15s as an advisory config pin only; outerabsolute15s is the actual bound. DisableRedirects only the two named cases. DefaultCLI retries remain disabled.
shared_boundaries.denominator: 10 fixed phaseA cases and6 fixed phaseB cases are observation scopes, not full replacementqualification. Individualinvariants reported distinctly; no dynamiccount is promoted to universalpass.
shared_boundaries.owner_cleanup: Use previously reviewed provisionalPopen registration/deferred-signal handler and exact PID/PGID/start identity. Track server sockets/threads; every failure closes listeners and bounded TERM/KILL/wait for this generation only.
shared_boundaries.private_output: 0700 root,0600 input/output/stderr, stdout/stderr/rawheaders never published. Publicreceipt contains closed case labels, process status, counts, boolean token equality, TLS protocol, bytecounts/digests and outputshape only.
shared_boundaries.qualification: PhaseA bug reproduction or phaseB completed observation cannot close REST200-vs307 or500-vs400 differences or backup restore validity.
shared_boundaries.source_and_evidence_fences: Exact executable/controller before-after hashes; old normal33 wire failedr2/r3 and officialoracle receipts unchanged; create-only newcase/run roots; no overwrite.
shared_boundaries.tls: Fresh owned CA and certs covering exact loopback origins; no skip-verify; badCA/downgrade are dedicated failclosed controls. Peer hosts/routes are closed fixed enums, no arbitrary redirectURL.
shared_boundaries.unknown_rule: Missing/unfinished request framing or nonterminal CLI is unknown and stops subsequent matrixcases. A known full error is retained and does not trigger a rerun. NegativeknownTLS/downgrade refusals are explicitly named observations.
